passlp.title: PassLP
passlp.description: Web ticketing platform for events, with event management, lots, checkout, users, roles, invitations, promoters and cloud deployment.
passlp.longDescription: Web ticketing platform for events with full event management, lots, checkout, users, roles, invitations, promoters and cloud deployment. Built for production with a focus on scalability and user experience.

agrocarteira.title: AgroCarteira
agrocarteira.description: Digital wallet for the Brazilian market, built as a companion app for TodoAgro, focused on transfers, security and mobile UX.
agrocarteira.longDescription: I developed new features for AgroCarteira, a digital wallet designed for the Brazilian market and built as a companion app for TodoAgro. I worked on key modules such as transfers (TED, boleto bancário, Pix and other methods), biometric access, notifications and overall UX improvements. I also helped configure the app for Android and iOS publishing, ensuring it passed both store review processes. The project was built with Clean Architecture and Screaming Architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.

todoagro.title: TodoAgro
todoagro.description: Agro marketplace app for Brazil featuring cart, checkout, purchases, notifications and an integrated AI assistant.
todoagro.longDescription: I developed several core features for TodoAgro, a mobile app focused on the Brazilian agro market. I built modules such as cart, checkout, product listing, purchase history, notifications and an integrated AI assistant that could answer questions about the app and about agriculture in general. I also helped configure the app for Android and iOS publishing, ensuring it passed both store review processes. The project followed Clean Architecture and Screaming Architecture principles.
highlights: Cart and checkout built from scratch

agronative.title: AgroNative UI Kit
agronative.description: Internal shared component library built to speed up mobile development across the Agro ecosystem.
agronative.longDescription: I built an internal reusable component library to share UI and patterns across AgroCarteira and TodoAgro. It was developed with React Native and TypeScript, and I also handled versioning and private npm publishing so the mobile team could use it efficiently. This library helped standardize components, reduce duplication and speed up development.

macrointell.title: MacroIntell App
macrointell.description: Internal app for weekly meal selection and company information for employees.
macrointell.longDescription: I worked on an internal app for MacroIntell that allows employees to select their meals for the following week, review their current selections and check company-related information. Besides contributing to development, I also mentored a newly joined teammate, guiding implementation decisions, answering questions and supporting the training process.

gillette.title: Gillette Beard Filter
gillette.description: Real-time desktop application to add or remove beard using computer vision, used in a Gillette campaign.
gillette.longDescription: I built a desktop application capable of adding or removing beard in real time using computer vision and locally executed models, fully offline. It was developed with Electron, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ml5 and FaceMesh. The solution was used in a Gillette campaign for Match 3 Carbono and deployed across more than 15 stores in Buenos Aires.

anavir.title: Ana-Vir
anavir.description: Full-stack platform for a livestock/consignment business, focused on transaction visibility and operational management.
anavir.longDescription: I built both the frontend and backend of Ana-Vir, a platform designed to help a consignment business manage and visualize information related to its transactions and land operations. The frontend was developed with React, Vite and TypeScript, while the backend used Node, Express and TypeScript. The project was deployed using Railway and Cloudflare.

posmart.title: Posmart
posmart.description: WhatsApp assistant built to simplify farm event logging and operational workflows.
posmart.longDescription: I worked with a team on Posmart and was responsible for the WhatsApp bot built with Node, Express and TypeScript. I configured the full Meta setup, including business portfolio, webhook, permissions and WhatsApp Business flows. The assistant helps simplify how farm events are recorded, such as animal purchases, deaths, paddock changes and other operational details. I used Whisper for audio transcription and GPT to decide dynamically which endpoint each message should call, complementing the experience with Meta forms and automation flows. I also helped configure staging environments for frontend, backend and bot using AWS, Railway and Cloudflare.

gymapp.title: GymApp
gymapp.description: Technical challenge app where I stood out by delivering not only the mobile app, but also backend, design and documentation.
gymapp.longDescription: GymApp was a technical challenge where I aimed to stand out by presenting a more complete product mindset. I built not only the mobile application, but also the backend, expanded the design in Figma, created flow diagrams, database models, ER diagrams and organized the work in Trello with detailed task breakdowns. This end-to-end presentation helped me stand out among more than 30 candidates and ultimately led me to joining Almoby.
